acquisition.policy: lock retrieval metadata is excluded from processed hashes

processing_policy.source_text: exact decoded UTF-8 text retained in each processed record; source SHA covers original bytes
processing_policy.hu_annotation_layer: balanced one-level parenthesized spans only when the file is balanced; otherwise unresolved interleaving is retained
processing_policy.kaoyi: whole evidence blocks retained; no source-choice adjudication
processing_policy.chronology: surface extraction only; no Gregorian normalization and no Story temporal anchors
